answer_prose: The average improvement over an earlier-year recorded best was 18.9 minutes. The final 12.195 km supplied 7.6 of those minutes: 37.5 seconds gained per km, versus 17.5 seconds per km in the opening 10 km.
detail_prose: This is a best within the recorded earlier-year history. Races absent from the export and other races in the same year prevent a lifetime-PB claim.
